body:
Shipped (8b892284, fast-forward-merged to main): normalized home/cwd
display to ~ in the system prompt (context_builder.py, keyed off the
real resolved home path so it covers Windows C:\Users\<user> too, not
just Unix regexes), added a "do NOT run pwd/Get-Location" guard next to
the Working directory line, fixed sysinfo's environment section reading
the server's own os.getcwd() instead of the session-tracked cwd, and
fixed agent_runtime only ever wiring shell's session-cwd ContextVar --
git_tool and process_tool declared the same pattern but were never
populated, so their commands silently ran from the server's cwd. 5 new
tests (test_context_builder.py, new test_sysinfo_session_cwd.py). Full
backend suite 3320 passed / 2 skipped (pre-existing environmental
skips), ruff clean.
